SELECT "Categories", "Message", "Time"
FROM public."system_log"
WHERE "Service" = 'AWS'
ORDER BY "Time" DESC

name: aws_utilisation
query:
SELECT
    standpipe,
    "Skid_ID",
    "AWT_ID",
    "Entry_Time",
    "Exit_Time",
    "Start_Time",
    "End_Time",
    "Start_Level",
    "End_Level",
    "Exit_Status",
    "Fill_Volume"
FROM public."aws_utilisation"
ORDER BY "Entry_Time" DESC
LIMIT 500;
